purpose: Regression suite for planner + KPI matcher behavior. This does not define KPIs; it verifies routing behavior for representative user questions.
why_this_exists: Protect against silent behavior drift when planner.py or kpi_matcher.py changes.
Confirm active KPI questions map to canonical KPI IDs.
Confirm blocked KPIs are recognized as blocked_by_missing_data guardrails.
Confirm generic analytics questions fall back to schema-grounded path (no KPI mapping).
how_to_use: Extend by adding cases under 'cases' with expected intent/time grain/KPI mapping.

cases.question: What is ID verification pass rate by provider this month?
What is waitlist approval rate by issuer type?
Top tokens traded in the last 7 days
How many users signed up this week?
List issuers with their country and level
How many tokens have been traded on average per day and how does it compare with the median traded per day?
